items.t: Automatic transmission loses gears or reverse
items.note: Owners report $1,400–$2,600 total. A used transmission costs less but carries more risk.

items.t: Lower ball joints wear out and can separate
items.job: Replace both front lower ball joints and align
items.note: More if control arms, tie rods or idler arm are also worn.

items.t: Intake manifold gasket leaks coolant
items.job: Replace intake manifold gaskets and coolant
items.note: Change the oil too if coolant got into it.

items.t: Central "spider" fuel injector sticks or leaks
Fuel pump quits without warning
Rear differential whine or groan
items.job: Rebuild rear differential (bearings, seals, gear setup)
items.note: Owners report about $2,200 for a full rebuild with axles; a used axle assembly can cost less.

items.t: Rusted brake lines and frame
items.job: Replace rusted brake lines (preformed line set) and bleed brakes
items.note: Frame rust repair is extra and varies widely.

items.t: Instrument cluster gauges stop working
items.job: Rebuild instrument cluster or replace gauge motors

items.t: Key won't turn or ignition switch fails
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder and/or ignition switch

items.t: Heater fan works only on high
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor (and blower motor if worn)

items.t: Oil pressure gauge drops or jumps
Misfire from worn distributor cap and rotor
items.job: Replace distributor cap, rotor and spark plug wires

items.t: Engine knock or ping on the 4.3L V6
items.note: If piston wear is found, engine repair costs far more.

items.t: Doors sag from worn hinge pins
items.job: Replace door hinge pins and bushings (one door)

items.t: A/C compressor leaks or seizes
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, drier and recharge
